claims.claim: Six planets orbit star HD110067 in orbital resonance with periods of 9.11, 13.67, and 20.52 days for the inner three.
claims.episode_span: The innermost completes an orbit in 9.11 days, the next in 13.67 days, and the third in 20.52 days.
claims.source_title: Planetary system in perfect harmony discovered
claims.supporting_quote: The innermost planet completes an orbit around the star in 9.11 days. The next takes 13.67 days. The third rounds out the inner trio with an orbital period of 20.52 days.

claims.claim: The whole-Earth simulation reproduces 19 planetary properties such as mantle heat flow when run without life.
claims.episode_span: It correctly reproduces 19 planetary properties including mantle heat flow.
claims.supporting_quote: the model reproduced 19 key observations of pre-industrial Earth within estimated measurement uncertainties

claims.claim: The ERMIS-3 8U CubeSat achieved an optical link with a ground station weeks after commissioning using Astrolight terminals.
claims.episode_span: The 8U ERMIS-3 CubeSat achieved an optical link with a ground station weeks after commissioning using terminals from Astrolight.
claims.source_title: CubeSat achieves challenging laser link to ground
claims.supporting_quote: Despite the complexity of the operation, ERMIS-3, an 8U CubeSat developed by the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, has established a link with an optical ground station, marking an important step in validating optical communications on small satellites. The demonstration, supported by the European Space Agency (ESA) and achieved using optical terminals developed by Lithuanian company Astrolight, happened only weeks after the satellite's commissioning.
